title: Compass (daily planner)
summary: Technical spec for the Compass agent, which merges Forge tasks with the calendar into a time-blocked day plan emitted to the Wire for Steward.
notes: Content is implementation-contract focused: merge/prioritization algorithm, free/busy grid, event JSON schema, config defaults, failure-mode table. Reads as SPEC rather than PRD (no user stories/acceptance criteria) or DOC (defines binding behavior the system must honor). 'Open questions' section poses unresolved design choices but does not lock any decision, so not an ADR.
